rationale: Motor vehicle collision with a totaled vehicle and bodily injury to the policyholder, clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9; policyholder's vehicle totaled with trunk crushed into back seat. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information documented on police report. Vehicle damage well exceeds $25,000.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling 35 mph without braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: car totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
